sentences.text:
== == =
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Raj Kumar, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Ms. Indu Kumari Srivastava, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 417,
418, 419, 420, 465, 466, 467, 468, 472, 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 66, 66(B),
66(C), 66(D) of the Information Technology Act.
3.
Petitioner is alleged to have committed cyber fraud by using mobile phones, fake sim cards, fake bank accounts and ATM cards.
4. Considering the nature of accusation, prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is refused.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Navya/-
